clips.title: The story
paras: Warsong overseers hold the eastern edge of their lumber camp at Kargathia Keep. The fortified stronghold guards the Southfury River border in Ashenvale and links the outpost to Orgrimmar.

Kargathia Keep anchors the eastern edge of the Warsong Lumber Camp, just west of the Southfury River. Spiked barricades fortify the outpost, where Overseer Gorthak and his officers direct the Horde’s logging operations. From the river border, the Warsong clan watches for incursions. When night elf skirmishers strike, reinforcements can come swiftly from Durotar and Orgrimmar.

Kargathia Keep shares its namesake with Kargath in the Badlands and Bladefist Bay on Durotar’s coast: the famed chieftain Kargath Bladefist. For Warsong orcs facing Ashenvale’s hostile woodlands, its imposing architecture speaks of martial resilience and Horde defiance in lands claimed by the night elves.
